correctness.rationale: Full exact enumeration: 27 Pappus edges, 35,368 matchings including empty, 216 graph automorphisms, 11 combined cycle profiles. Augmented mod-two boundary ranks (1,26,271,1448,4195,6362,4335,984,42) imply rational Betti 40 in degree five and zero otherwise via universal coefficients and reduced Euler characteristic -40. For each automorphism, two independent finite expressions (signed trace on fixed simplices and compatible edge-cycle polynomial) agree; their full weighted character sum is zero. The rational orbit-space homology follows from finite-group invariant-chain averaging after barycentric subdivision.

value.rationale: This exact natural high-symmetry graph carries a forty-dimensional matching-complex homology representation. Determining the entire 216-element character distinguishes all semisimple rational modules compatible with the known Betti count and yields the first full-symmetry quotient rational homology statement for this specified object. It is a complete natural classification, not an arbitrary subgroup trace or known-table recomputation. No claim of a broader family theorem or integral quotient type is made.
